body.name: Finite-unsupported-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction:
\(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{fin}}\) is the class of finite RSCMs over \(S\) and
\(G\) that induce the source groundings \(Rsrc\) and target grounding
\(\rho\) encoded by \(Ictx\), have mutually independent distinct exogenous
variables, have no ground endogenous variable with an exogenous relational
parent, have no non-relational exogenous variable that is a parent of two
distinct ground endogenous variables, have type-shared finite mechanisms,
reproduce \(Psrc\), use the recovered rows \(K\) at every target-relevant
positive-source-support key, and leave precisely the target-relevant keys in
\(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{free}}\) unrestricted over their native finite outcome
alphabets.
